violations.text: Milks, cream cheese and guacamole were observed held at 49-52 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Ambient of refrigerator was observed at 46 degrees Fahrenheit at onset of inspection. Foods were observed blocking air circulating vents which caused irregular air circulation. Items were removed from blocking air circulating vents. Foods out of temperature for an unknown amount of time were voluntarily disposed of. Unit's ambient temperature went down to 37 degrees Fahrenheit during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026

The condensate from the (refrigerator/freezer unit) refrigeration unit is draining onto the floor. Condensate drainage and other nonsewage liquids must drain into a drain. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2024
Three bay sink was lacking- food surface sanitizer. Sanitizer is required establishment is to purchase food surface sanitizer and test strips. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2024

There is insufficient refrigeration equipment/capacity to maintain a temperature of 41 degrees or below.There is insufficient hot holding equipment to maintain foods at 135 degrees F or above. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2024
